message:
## Vulnerability Digest

Eight consolidated findings were verified for six monitored product families during the last 24 hours. The highest-priority items are critical Veeam vulnerabilities, high-severity Ubiquiti device flaws, and Mozilla's high-impact Firefox security release.

**Scope:** `Products.txt` and `List_of_SIA_Completed.txt` only, combined with obvious aliases normalized and duplicates removed. `DLL_software_component.txt` was not read or combined.

**Scan window:** 2026-10-27 05:10 IST through 2026-10-28 05:10 IST (2026-10-26 23:40 UTC through 2026-10-27 23:40 UTC).

### Finding 1: Fortinet FortiOS — CVE-2026-106174

- **Severity:** Medium (vendor CVSS 3.1 score 6.7)
- **Description:** An unauthenticated network attacker can send crafted HTTP requests that cause a denial of service in the FortiOS HTTPS management interface.
- **Affected versions:** FortiOS 8.0.0 and 7.6.4 through 7.6.6.
- **Why relevant:** Fortigate/FortiOS is explicitly monitored.
- **Source:** [Fortinet PSIRT FG-IR-26-181](https://fortiguard.fortinet.com/psirt/FG-IR-26-181)

### Finding 2: Ubiquiti airMAX, LTU, SolarPoint and SolarSwitch — CVE-2026-116836 through CVE-2026-116839

- **Severity:** High (CVSS 3.1 score 8.8 for the disclosed issues)
- **Description:** Four related flaws include stored cross-site scripting with privilege escalation, a heap-based buffer overflow enabling code execution, and cross-site request-forgery paths leading to command injection or unauthorized changes and denial of service.
- **Affected versions:** airMAX M before 6.3.26; LTU PTMP before 2.4.2; LTU PTP before 1.5.7; SolarPoint/SolarSwitch before 2.0.3, as applicable.
- **Why relevant:** Ubiquiti/UniFi is explicitly monitored; these are Ubiquiti network-device product lines, though they are not UniFi products.
- **Source:** [Ubiquiti Security Advisory Bulletin 071](https://uisp.community.ui.com/releases/Security-Advisory-Bulletin-071/7d4d42cf-09e4-44d3-9c19-649cac8c6af3)

### Finding 3: Grafana — CVE-2026-16491

- **Severity:** Medium (CVSS 3.1 score 6.5)
- **Description:** Grafana's RBAC check could treat a user with dashboard permission-management rights on one folder as an administrator of other folders, exposing deleted dashboard items across folder boundaries.
- **Affected versions:** Grafana OSS 13.0.0 through 13.1.1 and specified Grafana Enterprise 13.0/13.1 ranges.
- **Why relevant:** Grafana is explicitly monitored. The approved version recorded in the SIA list (8.3.6) is outside the disclosed affected range.
- **Source:** [Grafana security advisory](https://grafana.com/security/security-advisories/cve-2026-16491)

### Finding 4: Ubuntu authd — CVE-2026-102631 / USN-8957-1

- **Severity:** Medium (Ubuntu CVSS 4.0 score 5.9)
- **Description:** Incorrect identity matching can cause a reassigned identity-provider username to inherit a previous user's local account and files, including potentially sensitive credentials.
- **Affected product:** Ubuntu 26.10 `authd`; the October 27 security notice supplies the fixed package.
- **Why relevant:** Ubuntu is explicitly monitored.
- **Source:** [Ubuntu USN-8957-1](https://ubuntu.com/security/notices/USN-8957-1)

### Finding 5: Veeam Backup & Replication and managed Veeam Agent for Linux — CVE-2026-108142, CVE-2026-108140, CVE-2026-108141 and CVE-2026-105477

- **Severity:** Critical for CVE-2026-108142 (CVSS 4.0 9.1); High for CVE-2026-105477 (7.3); Medium for the two path-traversal flaws (5.9)
- **Description:** The bulletin includes an unauthenticated CDP Coordinator authorization bypass, two authenticated arbitrary-path file-write issues, and local privilege escalation in managed Veeam Agent for Linux.
- **Affected versions:** Specified Veeam Backup & Replication 13.0/13.1 builds and managed Agent for Linux 13.1 builds.
- **Why relevant:** Veeam is explicitly monitored.
- **Source:** [Veeam KB4948](https://www.veeam.com/kb4948)

### Finding 6: Veeam Backup for Microsoft 365 — CVE-2026-106076, CVE-2026-106077, CVE-2026-106078 and CVE-2025-64394

- **Severity:** Critical for CVE-2026-106076 (CVSS 4.0 9.0); High for CVE-2026-106077 (8.3); Medium for the remaining issues
- **Description:** The disclosure covers SQL injection with cross-tenant configuration access and code execution, arbitrary file reads, REST API authentication bypass, and an installer file-write issue.
- **Affected versions:** Veeam Backup for Microsoft 365 8.5.0.1014 and earlier version 8 builds, with scope varying by CVE.
- **Why relevant:** The monitored Veeam entry is broad and this is an official Veeam product.
- **Source:** [Veeam KB4957](https://www.veeam.com/kb4957)

### Finding 7: Veeam ONE — CVE-2026-107671

- **Severity:** High (CVSS 4.0 score 8.5)
- **Description:** An attacker who already has valid Administrator credentials can disable MFA globally before completing MFA verification.
- **Affected versions:** Veeam ONE 13.1.0.7233 and earlier 13.1 builds.
- **Why relevant:** The monitored Veeam entry is broad and this is an official Veeam product.
- **Source:** [Veeam KB4951](https://www.veeam.com/kb4951)

### Finding 8: Mozilla Firefox and Firefox ESR — MFSA 2026-118, 2026-119 and 2026-120

- **Severity:** High overall, with additional Moderate and Low issues
- **Description:** Mozilla published a large coordinated CVE set affecting Firefox 159 and ESR 153.6/115.44, including sandbox escapes, use-after-free defects, privilege-escalation paths, same-origin and site-isolation bypasses, and information-disclosure flaws.
- **Why relevant:** Mozilla Firefox is explicitly monitored. The older approved version recorded in the SIA list is not evidence that current deployments remain on that version.
- **Sources:** [Firefox 159 advisory](https://www.mozilla.org/en-US/security/advisories/mfsa2026-118/), [Firefox ESR 153.6 advisory](https://www.mozilla.org/en-US/security/advisories/mfsa2026-120/), and [Firefox ESR 115.44 advisory](https://www.mozilla.org/en-US/security/advisories/mfsa2026-119/)

### Possible match needing review

**Google Chrome 156:** Google released desktop version 156.0.8078.73/.74 on October 27, but the release notice still says security changes will be added later. No vulnerability claim can yet be verified, so this is not counted as a finding. Source: [Chrome Stable Channel update](https://chromereleases.googleblog.com/2026/10/stable-channel-update-for-desktop_0562499947.html).

### MongoDB ecosystem verification

A dedicated sweep checked MongoDB Server Community and Enterprise, `mongod`, `mongos`, Atlas and Atlas services, Ops Manager, Cloud Manager, Compass, `mongosh`, Database Tools, Kubernetes Operator, drivers, connectors, BI Connector, Charts, Realm/App Services, official integrations, and major maintained libraries against MongoDB notices, CVE/NVD records, GitHub advisories, CISA-related sources, and credible security reporting. No MongoDB-related disclosure fell inside this scan window. CVE-2026-115930 for `mongosh` was published at 2026-10-26 14:02 UTC, before the window opened, and was excluded as stale.

### Review priority

Immediate review is recommended for affected Veeam, Ubiquiti, and Firefox deployments. FortiOS, Grafana, and Ubuntu assets should also be version-checked promptly. No active exploitation claim is made here unless stated by the cited vendor source.
